(2) A female speaker (animated tone) excitedly identifies the clothing as belonging to the singer HOCC. A comedic 'pop' sound effect punctuates the reveal. (3) The interviewer reacts with a loud, surprised 'HOCC!?' (high arousal). A second male voice chimes in with rapid speech, inquiring about the item's history. (4) A 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a cut. The female speaker explains the jacket was from an awards ceremony. The background chatter of the group and distant laughter are audible. (5) The male in the white shirt speaks at a very fast rate, explaining how he bought the jacket for 600 HKD from HOCC's mother. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat rhythm. (6) The interviewer asks a final comedic question about cheating, leading to a burst of collective laughter and a final upbeat musical stinger as the segment concludes.
